items.title: CI's `vilan-fmt` leg scans `target/`: the test suite leaves unformatted scratch projects under `target/tmp`, so `scripts/ci-local.sh vilan-fmt` goes red after any local full suite
items.body: Fix: the leg skips `target/` (and any ignored directory), or the tests clean up. Sizing XS.

items.discussion: fix-45 (Order 45); B277's pin (fixed a2245c37 — a 10 ms sleep against a 50 ms window failed on a Windows runner)
items.title: other `Debounce` pins use 50 ms windows against fixed sleeps and carry the same margin risk on a loaded Windows runner
items.body: Sweep `crates/vilan-cli/tests/debounce.rs` and the std `Debounce` pins; widen each window past any plausible stall, with the reason in a comment. Sizing S.

items.title: a `macro fun` declared inside an inline `mod { }` is not in scope for an attribute in that same `mod` ("no macro named `tabled` is in scope")
items.body: May be by design (macros resolve at file scope). Decide and either fix or document with a steer. Sizing S.
